{{Character Infobox |color={{poison color}} |corecolor={{poison color light}} |bordercolor={{poison color dark}} |name=Youssef |jname=ヒロノブ |tmname=Hironobu |jtranslit=Hironobu |text=fff |image=VSYoussef V.png |size=150px |caption=VS model in Violet |gender=Male |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Paldea]] |eyes=Gray |hair=Black }} {{Character Infobox/Game |color={{poison color light}} |gen={{gen|IX}} |games={{pkmn|Scarlet and Violet|Scarlet, Violet}} |trainer=[[Pokémon Trainer]] }} |} '''Youssef''' (Japanese: '''ヒロノブ''' ''Hironobu'') is a minor [[non-player character]] in {{g|Scarlet and Violet}}. He is a student at [[Naranja Academy]]{{sup/9|S}}/[[Uva Academy]]{{sup/9|V}}. He is close companions with [[Atticus]], whom he respectfully refers to as '''Don Atticus''' (Japanese: '''シュウメイ殿''' ''Shūmei-dono'') ==In the core series games== Youssef is first encountered outside the entrance of [[Navi Squad's Base]], where he battles the {{player}} to try and stop them from raiding it. After Atticus is defeated by the player, Youssef helps him come to terms with his loss by reminding him of their friendship. During the post-game, Youssef makes a brief appearance during Atticus's section of [[Penny]]'s [[bond]] story. At the school store in Naranja Academy{{sup/9|S}}/Uva Academy{{sup/9|V}}, Atticus is infuriated to learn that another student had purchased a pair of ninja costumes he was intending to buy. He is calmed down by Youssef, who reveals that he was the one who bought the costumes. {{color2|fff|Pokémon Scarlet and Violet|Violet}} |} ==In the manga== [[File:Youssef Adventures.png|thumb|220px|Youssef in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Scarlet & Violet}}==== Youssef debuted in [[PASV20]]. At [[Tagtree Thicket]], he saw [[Clavell]] disguised as a student named Clive and assumed he was trying to raid the [[Navi Squad's Base]]. Youssef launched a sneak attack, but was easily fended off. Admitting defeat, Youssef explained he wasn't a [[Team Star]] member, but was close friends with [[Atticus]], the Navi Squad boss. To his shock, Clavell revealed that he learned about an internal conflict within Team Star. Several Grunts planned to launch a coup, defeat the remaining bosses, and reform Team Star to suit their benefits. Clavell assured Youssef he meant Team Star no harm and asked that he cooperate with him. In [[PASV22]], after Clavell was taken into the base, Youssef learned that the raid had already started and ran off to where Atticus was. He and Clavell found Atticus in battle with {{Scarlet}}, who had disguised herself as {{Violet}}. Despite having her vision severely impaired by one of Atticus's ninja techniques, Scarlet eventually won the battle. Accepting his defeat, Atticus stepped down as squad boss and healed Scarlet, only for her to harshly criticize his cruel actions in their battle, stating they made him no better than the bullies that led to Team Star's formation in the first place. While Scarlet and {{adv|Nemona}} left, Clavell stayed behind to discuss Team Star-related matters with Youssef and the others. In [[PASV24]], Youssef questioned Scarlet's harsh words towards Atticus, noting that deceitful tactics are normal when defending oneself. Atticus stated that Scarlet was in the right and revealed that she never issued a formal raid challenge. He admitted that his behavior during their battle was due to being angered when Scarlet made fun of his ninja hobby and apologized to his subordinates for how he acted. ===Pokémon=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Youssef |pkmn=Gulpin |type1=Poison |img=Youssef Gulpin Adventures.png |epnum=PASV20 |desc={{p|Gulpin}} is Youssef's first known Pokémon.
